rarity_system: No in-game rarity tier or colour-coding for vehicles was found in any guide searched: a targeted search for colour/rarity labels returned nothing. What the game does have is a 'Standout Vehicle' category: one-off custom versions of ordinary models (unique livery, parts and slightly better stats) parked at fixed spawns and tracked in the in-game vehicle log. Guides count 280-281 of them (GTABase and IGN: 281; one map: 280; other maps so far list 85-225), split into 25 subtypes (e.g. Ultra-Luxe, Street Racer, Retro, All-Terrain, Lowriders, Hot Rods, Choppers, Toppers, Stock Car, Pedal Power, Leonida Man), alongside about 277 regular vehicles. Separately, every car has a tracker level shown by a WAiNK app scan (none / standard / advanced) that decides where it can be registered or sold: no tracker - Moses in Port Gellhorn (first registration free); standard tracker - any Pay 'n' Spray; advanced tracker - supercars, with Randy as the main buyer. There are no car dealerships: a stolen car must be registered and needs a free owned-vehicle slot. The legendary / epic / rare values in this file are this map's own tiers (legendary = one-off, gold or unique-livery; epic = supercars and top-tier wish-list or container finds; rare = other fixed spawns), not an in-game label; the game's or guide's own label is in guide_label.
research_notes: Researched 2026-11-24 with web search only. Direct page fetches were blocked by the session network policy, so every fact comes from search-result summaries and excerpts of the cited pages, not from reading the full pages. Spot-check before publishing.

The shared web-search budget for this session ran out before the planned Russian-language queries, the Reddit/YouTube/TikTok pass, the IGN and PowerPyx standout lists and the full GTABase standout map (281 entries) could be covered. Only two showgamer.com (Russian site) pages surfaced, via English queries.

verified=true means at least two independent guides were reported to agree on the vehicle and its location. Where the summary did not say which page made a claim, sources lists the pages from that result set and the item note says so.

Randy's Wish List: most guides say 20 cars (Push Square, GameRant, Game8); others count 16, 17 or 22. Game8 notes each wish-list car can appear in several places, so some 'conflicts' may be alternative spawns.
Moses Drop-Offs: 7 vehicles, unlocked in Port Gellhorn in Chapter 2; guides agree on four and differ on the rest.
Wyman's Classic Car Collection is Ultimate Edition only: Dominator Buggy opens it, then five restorations.

Model-year placement in names varies between guides (e.g. "'96 Infernus" vs "Infernus '96"). Vehicle class values are descriptive (guide wording or series convention), not an official GTA 6 class list.
Region is null where no source stated the county for that district (e.g. Capri, Hamlet, Ambrosia, La Perle, Crosstown, Tequesta Retreat).
